$comment: Generated by tools/Avalon.Exporter -- item-modifier-catalog, from the seed. Do not edit by hand. kind: 1 prefix, 2 suffix, 3 unique, 4 implicit. element (a family split by element): 0 physical, 1 fire, 2 cold, 3 lightning, 4 blight. tier: 1-9 on a prefix, suffix or implicit, counting down (9 the weakest), null on a unique. stat: the StatType numbers of item-schema-v1.json; min2 and max2 are the high end of an "adds X to Y" line, null on every other. templates: the modifiers every copy of a template rolls when it is made, in order: a base's implicit at its tier, a unique's own modifier (a unique's copy rolls its base's implicit first: baseTemplateId in item-catalog-v1.json).
